name: Revdoku
description: Email inboxes with shared file storage for people and AI agents. Receive and read messages and attachments, and share files through authorized bucket access.
capabilities: Receive email and attachments at each bucket's incoming address
List messages with polling cursors, read decoded email, and download originals and attachments with email tools
Store documents, data, and source files in private cloud buckets
Share bucket files with authorized people and AI connections
Read, write, and append shared files; coordinate edits with locks and revision checks
Inspect versions and change history; restore earlier files
Sign up in the browser, then connect an existing account
